Harikatha on Hotstar

This campaign used the power of social media to promote Harikatha on Hotstar, driving audience engagement and viewership. With strong results on Instagram and X (Twitter), it expanded the show's reach and created significant buzz.

Campaign summary

On Instagram the campaign reached over 78 lakh people, beating its 70 lakh target, through 35 posts from 35 different pages that generated 8.35 lakh views. On X it engaged over 17 lakh people, beating its 15 lakh target, with 38 posts from 38 influencers. #HarikathaonHotstar trended at No. 1 nationally for over an hour with 84 lakh impressions. Total cumulative views and reach, excluding the trend, came to 10.95 lakh.
